evals.name: Trigger - Decompose an accepted greenfield backlog
evals.prompt: Turn these accepted greenfield requirements into a repository-native backlog. Some slices fit one session, but the planned backlog must persist across the project.
evals.expected_output: A compact v1 feature index and coherent feature details with stable IDs, real dependencies, and observable acceptance.
expectations: Tracks planned one-session slices because the backlog itself is project memory
Uses dependencies only for execution prerequisites and never as priority
Does not automatically choose or promote one eligible feature
Adds only one minimal instruction route to feature state

evals.name: Workflow - Maintain concurrent lifecycle truth
evals.prompt: Two features are genuinely in progress. Complete one whose Safari check has an accepted exception, keep the other in progress, and report eligible todo candidates without selecting one.
evals.expected_output: Truthful concurrent statuses, a durable accepted exception, cleaned completion state, and no inferred priority.
expectations: Allows multiple in_progress records and treats status as non-ownership
Records the unmet check, reason, accepting authority, and follow-up in feature detail
Removes stale Handoff and blocker before marking done
Preserves unrelated dirty code and runs or directly performs structural state validation

evals.name: Rerun - Preserve IDs and completed exceptions
evals.prompt: Rerun feature maintenance with unchanged planned work after a human edited acceptance wording and retained a still-relevant completion exception.
evals.expected_output: A semantic no-op that preserves stable IDs, acceptance, exception authority, and external references.
expectations: Does not rename IDs or reorder entries to imply priority
Does not delete the accepted exception during completed-detail compaction
Does not recreate an intentionally removed optional progress artifact

evals.name: No trigger - Clear ad-hoc task with sufficient tracker
evals.prompt: Fix this one-session bug. The assigned external issue already contains scope, acceptance, and handoff, and no repository backlog exists.
evals.expected_output: harness-features should not trigger or should make an evidence-backed no-op.
expectations: Creates no feature_index.json or feature detail
Does not mirror tracker metadata or reverse-engineer existing functionality
